categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Build system' label and directly edits CMakeLists.txt to configure Darwin linker flags.
categories.rationale: Reduces Darwin binary sizes by enabling identical code folding in the build system. Benchmarks indicate ~5% savings across Darwin release binaries ('~0.5mb' for bitcoind and '1.3mb' for bitcoin-qt), offering a modest and deferrable build optimization.
